data.narrative:
Anello Photonics is a Series B-2 stage company in Defense & Security that has raised $50M+. The broader sector peer universe comprises 21 companies, including 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers spanning various maturity levels. Top private reference points include Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems, though none represent tight stage or valuation tier matches.

Peer-median valuation proved inapplicable due to insufficient narrow peer density. Zero same-stage, zero adjacent-stage, and zero similar-tier comparables were identified within Defense & Security, falling below the three-datapoint threshold required for reliable median estimation. A sector-wide median would introduce excessive heterogeneity across funding stages and business models and was not pursued.

Given the constrained peer set and methodological limitations, a triangulated valuation range cannot be responsibly derived from the available data. The company operates in a fragmented sector with sparse public market signals and limited private comparables at equivalent development stage. Proceeding would require either: (1) relaxing stage/tier filters with explicit discount/premium adjustments, or (2) applying alternative methods (DCF, revenue multiple analysis) contingent on access to financial projections. Key uncertainties include revenue scale, margin profile, and customer concentration—all material to Defense & Security valuation but absent from the current dataset.
